items.rationale: Translating the police report is claim substantiation, excluded under 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f). Case 31 revealed t = 0 for the same line.
Working material raised alongside the translation charge is excluded under 7.1.8(e) and (f). Case 31 revealed t = 0.

7.1.9 limits the line to an equivalent of the ~EUR 7,000 watch, but the valuables sub-limit of EUR 2,500 per item (4.2.2, no valuables schedule) caps it at 2,500. Watch plus cash stays within the EUR 5,000 away-from-premises cap; Case 31 revealed about 3,000 combined, so no deductible is shown here.

items.description: Compensation for cash taken in robbery
items.rationale: The means-of-payment sub-limit of EUR 500 (2.3.2, 4.2.3) applies to the EUR 900 of cash taken, so the line is capped at 500.
The sunglasses were not an affected item: they were lost on a separate occasion without force or threat, so 2.3.4(a) and 7.1.10 exclude them.
Carriage and forwarding charges are excluded under 7.1.8(b). Case 31 revealed t = 0 for the same line.
